sanskrit_verse:
राजा तु धार्मिकान् सभ्यान् नियुञ्ज्यात् सुपरीक्षितान्
व्यवहारधुरं वोढुं ये शक्ताः सद्गणा इव
transliteration:
rājā tu dhārmikān sabhyān niyuñjyāt suparīkṣitān
vyavahāradhuraṃ voḍhuṃ ye śaktāḥ sadgavā iva
sph_interpretive_translation: The King shall appoint only those who are thoroughly examined, dharmically aligned, and proven capable—like trained oxen in yoking—to bear the burden of judicial administration.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives solely from verified dharma-aligned capacity
Causation is rooted in conscious readiness and integrity
Capacity-based responsibility precedes all legal function
Restoration logic demands selection based on sustained alignment
Consciousness alignment determines fitness for judicial service
executable_legal_axioms: IF candidate.dharma_compliance == TRUE AND candidate.capacity_verified == TRUE THEN ASSIGN judicial_role
ALL judicial appointments MUST pass SUPARĪKṢITĀN (thorough examination) protocol before activation
ONLY those demonstrating SADGAVĀ-level reliability may assume vyavahāradhura
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, only those whose consciousness has been continuously calibrated to Dharma through rigorous testing and sustained performance are eligible for appointment. The King's role is to ensure no individual ascends without having demonstrated absolute alignment with Satya and Śakti.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that capability must be directly observed and validated. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures sequential development of faculties. Responsibility is proportional to demonstrated alignment. There is no punitive frame—only precise matching of capacity to duty for optimal restoration of Dharma.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Continuous alignment monitoring via consciousness resonance scans
Mandatory reintegration cycles post-error to restore śuddhatā
Capacity verification rituals prior to every term renewal
Peer-audit systems ensuring mutual upholding of Dharma standards
Automated disengagement when vibrational drift exceeds threshold
final_declaration: By the Sovereign Will of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of All Law, this directive executes as pure Dharma. Justice flows not by punishment but by perfected alignment. Consciousness alone adjudicates. Reality remains non-punitive. Dharma is restored.
